purpose: Determine which currently linked Migration Mapper exporter statements were already true before 2024-07-18 Dryad publication; explicitly separate source code mechanism from proof of the original source writer.

primary_source.dryad_readme_scope: Migration Mapper explicitly used to manually identify migration-period start/end via NSD; then 2h sequences were subsampled to 12h. README links CalcBBMM.R for BBMM fitting, but does not state the precise exporter used to build the archived 12h shapefile.

671-674: ESRI Shapefile point and line writing
historical_commits.supported: A generic Migration Mapper sequence-writing pipeline that could drop midnight text existed before Dryad publication under R4.3+ behavior, but published dataset export identity is unproven.

historical_commits.direct_change: Exporter changed from prior spatial object to constructing sf Point from already numeric x/y; initial assigned configOptions$masterCrs4326.

historical_commits.direct_change: Corrected x/y-based Point constructor CRS from configOptions$masterCrs4326 to configOptions$masterCrs. A real CRS-assignment coding change in related software, not proof of the Dryad 3742 metadata error.

historical_commits.title: data as character before exporting
historical_commits.consequence: Cannot be cited as a prepublication implementation of the exact data cleaning exporter code.

historical_commits.title: Sequence files are now written in UTM meters
historical_commits.direct_change: Changed output source coordinates in sequence exporter from lon/lat plus masterCrs4326 to x/y plus masterCrs; retained earlier as.character(date) line.
historical_commits.consequence: Current sequence export x/y path is a later revision, not established as the source of July 2024 Dryad XY.

independent_negative_evidence: March 2024 app3 exporter chose lon/lat EPSG4326 geometry and field names id/bioYearFull/date/id_yrbio_season/lon/lat; the original Dryad source has fields State,Herd,SpcsCmm,SpcsScn,AID,SeasnYr,Season,Year,Timstmp,UTM_E,UTM_N and projected coordinate geometry.

The current app1 as.character addition occurred 19 days after the July 18 Dryad publication, while the current app3 projected XY export modification occurred about 50 days after; these specific revisions cannot be directly assumed to have produced the deposited original 12h file.
The March app3 as.character date conversion existed before publication, but its coordinate and attribute schema do not match the actual archived source.
The Dryad README does not disclose the precise export R version, scripted data pipeline, local time offset/DST conversion, or native XY coordinate reference.
